text:
sasha: Quick Q — auditor asked for a correlation matrix that ties RBAC changes to KMS key usage + audit logs for the last 90 days. They want chain-of-custody evidence for 3 production-impacting role changes and the matching KMS decrypts. Any recommendations on the cleanest export we can hand them?

eric: We should pull CloudTrail/KMS events + our k8s audit logs and the IAM change history. For the role changes include the iam:PutRolePolicy/AttachRolePolicy events and the exact change diff from terraform state or our infra-change log. :thumbsup:

auditor_jen: For scope: pick the 3 role change PRs in prod that Sasha references, and give me the matching KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events and any service account token usage around the same timeframe. Prefer a CSV matrix: change-id -> actor -> timestamp -> affected-key-id -> decrypt-counts + raw events.

lina: Splunk query we usually run for this:
```splunk
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) keyId=\"*\" | stats count by userIdentity.arn, keyId, eventName, _time
```
That gives quick counts per user/key. For the RBAC side:
```splunk
index=cloudtrail eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy | table userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters, _time
```

raj: We also have k8s audit entries in S3 under s3://redwood-audit/k8s/prod/YYYYMMDD/*. If the service account change is in-cluster, pull those audit lines and correlate token create/use with KMS activity window. 

sam-oncall: For evidence delivery, I recommend we use the evidence CLI to package artifacts + signed manifest so auditors have verifiable checksum/timestamps. Example usage: 
```
./redwood-evidence-cli package \
  --controls RBAC,KMS,LOGGING \
  --start 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z --end 2025-03-31T23:59:59Z \
  --include cloudtrail,k8s_audit,iam_changes \
  --output evidence-soc2-2025-q1.tar.gz
```
The tool will attach checksums and a small manifest.json with the list of exported files. evidence-bot can notarize.

evidence-bot: Notarization queued :wave: — manifest hash: sha256:3f7b2c9a...; ready for packaging after artifacts uploaded to /tmp/evidence-soc2-2025-q1.

auditor_jen: Can you include one raw KMS event example for my reviewers so they see all fields? A small JSON snippet is fine.

eric: here's a redacted KMS CloudTrail event sample (remove account ids):
```json
{
  "eventVersion": "1.08",
  "userIdentity": {
    "type": "AssumedRole",
    "arn": "arn:aws:sts::REDACTED:assumed-role/prod-inference-role/2025-02-14T12:34:56Z"
  },
  "eventTime": "2025-02-14T12:34:59Z",
  "eventName": "Decrypt",
  "awsRegion": "us-west-2",
  "requestParameters": {
    "encryptionContext": {"job":"inference-1234"},
    "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:REDACTED:key/abcd-1234"
  },
  "responseElements": {
    "plaintextLength": 256
  }
}
```

lina: Great. For chain-of-custody, include the PR link + commit hash that triggered the role change, the terraform plan/apply logs (or console approval screen if manual), plus the CloudTrail event that shows the actor. Put them in a folder per change: change-<id>/pr.md, iam-event.json, kms-events.json, checksums.txt.

raj: Also attach a short vuln-triage note if any of those changed roles were tied to an urgent vuln remediation — auditors like to see rationale. Link format: RED-INC-2025-042 (if applicable).

auditor_jen: Perfect — one ask: please include timezone-normalized timestamps (ISO 8601 UTC) in the CSV matrix and a README that maps our internal IDs to the auditor-friendly labels.

sasha: Sounds actionable. Who can own the export and target a handoff tomorrow afternoon? I can collate the PRs. :eyes:

eric: I can run the Splunk queries and export CloudTrail/KMS slices. Give me the 3 PR IDs, I'll filter and drop jsons into the evidence staging dir.

sasha: PRs are #4521, #4588, #4623. I'll drop links in this thread. ETA tomorrow 3pm PT?

sam-oncall: I'll run the evidence-cli packaging and notarize with evidence-bot once Eric/Lina upload. Expect the signed tarball + manifest by 2025-02-20T22:00:00Z.

lina: I'll grab k8s audit logs and produce the correlation CSV for token usage.

sasha: Thanks all — tagging @auditor_jen so you're in the loop. I'll follow up with the PR links now. :thumbsup:
